definitions.gloss: secretiveness; secretive nature; tendency to keep things private
definitions.explanation: A personal trait or habitual attitude of keeping information, feelings, or plans hidden from others.

definitions.gloss: policy of secrecy; principle of confidentiality
definitions.explanation: An organizational or institutional approach that prioritizes withholding information from the public or outsiders.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧ (secret) + ⟦{主義|しゅぎ}→主義：03215_shugi⟧ (-ism; principle). When describing a person, it characterizes someone who habitually keeps things to themselves and doesn't share personal information easily. When describing an organization, it refers to a deliberate policy of restricting information.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {秘密|ひみつ}{主義|しゅぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貫|つらぬ}く→貫く：18728_tsuranuku⟧: to maintain one's secretiveness
- {秘密|ひみつ}{主義|しゅぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a secretive person
- ⟦{徹底|てってい}した→徹底する：21452_tetteisuru⟧{秘密|ひみつ}{主義|しゅぎ}: thorough secretiveness

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧: secret — a single piece of hidden information, not a habitual trait
- ⟦{隠|いん}{蔽|ぺい}→隠蔽：07627_inpei⟧: concealment; cover-up — implies deliberate hiding of wrongdoing
- ⟦{口|くち}が{堅|かた}い→口が堅い：06885_kuchigakatai⟧: tight-lipped — a positive trait of being good at keeping secrets
